facts.business: Meyer Apparel Limited is engaged in the retailing of men's garments and manufacturing through contractors.

auditor.name: Khandelwal Jain & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has incurred a net loss of Rs. 78.80 Lakhs during the year and accumulated losses of Rs. 6,296.12 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, resulting in erosion of net worth and current liabilities exceeding current assets by Rs. 3,356.10 Lakhs. The financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis based on management's confidence of generating cash flows.

key_risks: Highly competitive and saturated market environment with pricing pressures
Uncertain demand patterns and seasonal fluctuations
Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses, erosion of net worth, and current liabilities exceeding current assets
Significant open litigation and contingent liabilities requiring management judgement
